roster.note: India's first Moon mission — its impactor and instruments find clear evidence of water molecules across the lunar surface, a discovery that reshaped how we understand the Moon

roster.name: Chandrayaan-2
roster.note: the orbiter succeeded and still works, but the Vikram lander crashed on final descent — a public, painful near-miss at the south pole
the return: Vikram lands softly near the lunar south pole — the first spacecraft ever to do so, making India the fourth nation to land on the Moon
